subject: 8 oz kraft cups
body:
Hi do you have the 8 oz kraft paper cups in stock? I need 2 cases for my coffee cart. How much would shipping be to Rexburg ID 83440?

thanks!
Kelsey
needs_human_reason: Simple stock question answered from the catalog. Shipping is calculated at checkout per policy (not guessed).
summary: Coffee cart wants 2 cases of 8 oz kraft hot cups (KR-08, in stock, $159.98) and a shipping quote to Rexburg. Told her shipping is calculated at checkout, with a Cup Club tip.
draft_reply:
Hi Kelsey,

Yes, our 8 oz kraft hot cups (KR-08) are in stock. 2 cases (1,000 cups each) are 2 x $79.99 = $159.98.

We can't quote shipping by email, since it's calculated at checkout based on weight and ZIP code. You'll see the exact amount for 83440 before you pay.

A money-saving tip: our Cup Club Rewards is free to join and gives free ground shipping on stock orders of $199 or more. For example, adding a case of our black 8 oz hot cup lids (LID-80B, $49.99) brings you to $209.97, over the line.

Orders placed before 2 pm ship within 1 business day.

The UNIQ Supply Team
